rationale: Third-party bodily injury (child's broken wrist) arising from an unsafe condition on the policyholder's premises (icy walkway), clearly fitting the liability coverage definition.
claim_summary: Neighbor's 9-year-old daughter slipped and fell on the policyholder's icy walkway during last week's ice storm, resulting in a broken wrist. Third-party bodily injury claim under homeowners liability coverage. Medical bills are pending quantification.

case_facts.injury_description: broken wrist from slip and fall
